chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A man forgot the two cycles behind the Standing Place of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and did not remember until he traveled from Mecca. He (peace be upon him) said: So let him pray them where he remembered, and when he remembered them while he is in the city, he should not leave until he fulfills them.

key_terms.خَلْفَ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: behind the Standing Place of Ibrahim

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pilgrim who forgets the two cycles behind Maqam Ibrahim until leaving Mecca?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of *qada* (making up missed acts) for the two rak'ahs of Tawaf, emphasizing that the obligation remains tied to the location of the Kaaba. The condition of not leaving Mecca until completion underscores the sanctity of the city and ensures the pilgrim does not depart with an outstanding ritual debt, reflecting the Shia emphasis on precise adherence to ritual completeness. This highlights the juristic view that the two rak'ahs are an integral part of the Tawaf ritual rather than a separate optional prayer.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Safwan Bin Yahya, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man forgot the two Cycles (to be Prayed) behind the Standing Place of Ibrahim<sup>as</sup>. So he did not remember until he travelled from Makkah’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So let him Pray these two while he is (still) in the city, so he should not return until he has fulfilled these two’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from and Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from ibn abu ‘Umayr and from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who forgets the two Rak‘at Salat (prayer) behind Maqam (station) of Ibrahim ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and does not remember until he leaves Makkah. He (the Imam) said, ‘He must perform them when he remembers. If he remembers when he still is in the town, he must not leave before performing the two Rak‘at Salat (prayer).”’
